summary: FuelCell Energy Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Capital Equipment Purchase Agreement with Fit Energy USA LP to manufacture and deliver up to 380 MW of carbonate fuel cell blocks in phases for data center baseload power. The initial 30 MW phase is effective; further phases are at Fit's option with milestone payments. Concurrently, the company issued warrants to purchase up to 12 million shares at $26.44, vesting upon receipt of non-refundable deposits. This is a commercial supply agreement with an equity kicker, not a change-of-control or capital-return event. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for deposit milestones to gauge commitment.
